Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, docs on doc_id, compound_records on record_id, and compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assay_chembl_id CHEMBL1865, standard_type IC50, and pubmed_id is not null. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
